target.name: Element Client — Enter to select, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove

uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Participant — Client":
  - heading "Participant — Client" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Identifier
  - textbox "Identifier": Client
  - text: Display label
  - textbox "Display label": Client
  - text: Highlight color (#hex or name)
  - textbox "Highlight color (#hex or name)"
  - text: Texture
  - combobox "Texture":
    - option "None" [selected]
    - option "Hatched"
    - option "Crosshatch"
    - option "Dotted"
    - option "Grid"
    - option "Striped"
  - group "Lifeline":
    - text: Lifeline
    - button "Add an activate Client bar": + activate
    - button "Add a deactivate Client marker": + deactivate
    - button "Mark Client as destroyed (X)": + destroy
  - paragraph: Press Delete to remove. Press F2 to focus the name. Drag to reposition.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
